messages.content:
На полке нет товара "Кефира 2.5% Молочный Знак, 900 мл".

Вот несколько альтернативных товаров, которые я нашел на сайте магазина Перекресток:
4261311 Кефир 1% Молочный Знак, 900мл, 0 шт.
4198906 Кефир 3.2% Молочный знак, 900мл, 0 шт.
4198905 Молоко питьевое пастеризованное 2.5% Молочный знак, 900мл, 0 шт.
4174038 Кефир 3.2% Молочный знак, 430мл, 0 шт.
4193022 Молоко Отборное пастеризованное 3.4-6% Молочный знак, 900мл, 0 шт.
4230577 Мороженое Ванильное сливочное 8% Молочный знак, 80г, 0 шт.

Подбери отсортируй товары как лучший по рейтингу какой товар может быть лучшей заменой

function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL to retrieve weather data from the Open-Meteo API. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: URL of the Open-Meteo API endpoint.

headers.description: Headers to include in the request. Each key-value pair represents a header field and its value.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept.description: Media type(s) that is/are acceptable for the response.

timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters for the GET request.

latitude.description: Latitude of the location, positive for N and negative for S. This is a float type value.

longitude.description: Longitude of the location, positive for E and negative for W. This is a float type value.

elevation.description: Elevation in meters above sea level for the location. The default value represents no elevation downscaling.

auth.description: Authentication tuple for HTTP authentication, in the format (username, password).

cert.description: Path to the SSL client certificate file (.pem). A null value means no client certificate is used.

cookies.description: Dictionary of cookies to send with the request. Each key represents a cookie name.

proxies.description: Dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy. Each key-value pair represents a protocol and its proxy URL.

stream.description: If True, the response should be streamed; otherwise, it should be downloaded immediately.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate.

message.content: К сожалению, у меня нет доступа к данным о рейтингах товаров в магазине «Перекрёсток», поэтому я не могу точно оценить, какой из перечисленных вариантов будет лучшим заменителем «Кефира 2.5 % Молочный Знак, 900 мл». Если вы можете предоставить рейтинги или отзывы по каждому из этих товаров, я с удовольствием помогу вам выбрать наиболее подходящий вариант.

They want me to pick the best replacement based on rating. I need to fetch ratings for each product. Use the Open-Meteo API? No, that's irrelevant. We need to get product ratings from the Перекресток site. But we don't have an API. We might need to simulate or guess. The user wants me to sort the products as best by rating. I can use the product IDs to query some API? There's no function for that. The only function available is requests_get for Open-Meteo. That doesn't help. So I cannot fetch ratings. I could respond that I can't fetch ratings. Or I could provide a suggestion based on typical preferences: 2.5% kefir is similar to 3.2% kefir but lower fat. The user might prefer 3.2% kefir if they want a richer taste. But the question is about rating. Without data, I can't rank. I can say I don't have rating data. I can ask for more info. Or I can provide a general recommendation: 3.2% kefir might be better. But the user specifically asked to sort by rating. I can't do that. So I should explain that I don't have access to rating data.
